description: This file defines the DeviceModelCatalog structure and associated functions to load, parse, and interpret device model identifiers, providing presentation information like device titles and symbols based on model and family identifiers.

classes.name: DeviceModelCatalog
classes.description: A utility enum providing static methods and properties to load device model mappings, determine device symbols, and provide device presentations based on device identifiers.

methods.name: presentation
methods.description: Generates a DevicePresentation object containing title and symbol based on device family and model identifiers.

methods.name: symbol
methods.description: Determines the device symbol based on device family, model identifier, and optional friendly name.

methods.name: symbolFor
methods.description: Maps a model identifier and friendly name to a device symbol string.

methods.name: fallbackSymbol
methods.description: Provides a fallback device symbol based on device family when specific mapping isn't available.

methods.name: loadModelIdentifierToName
methods.description: Loads a combined dictionary mapping device model identifiers to their human-readable names from JSON resources.

methods.name: loadMapping
methods.description: Loads a specific JSON resource mapping device identifiers to names.

methods.name: locateResourceBundle
methods.description: Locates the appropriate resource bundle containing device identifier JSON files.

methods.name: bundleIfContainsDeviceModels
methods.description: Checks whether a bundle contains device model JSON resources, returning the bundle if it does.
